name: TitleBar
purpose: Official Navigation sidebar brand header: logo + title + subtitle with default home activation and brand chrome (no select / no context menu). Mount in Navigation header / #header — not AppShell header (that is NavigationTitle).
scenarios: Put product logo + name + tagline above the Navigation destination list in the sidebar rail
Collapse the tablet rail so only the mark (or letter fallback) remains
Activate the brand to return home via homeHref or onBrandClick without consumer chrome CSS

title.description: Product name; accessible name of the brand control.

subtitle.description: Short tagline; hidden when density is compact or Navigation is collapsed.

logoSrc.description: Raster logo URL (png/jpeg/webp). Prefer logo / #logo for SVG or Icon.

logoAlt.description: Alt text for logoSrc; defaults to title.

logo.description: Custom mark (SVG/Icon). Wins over logoSrc. Vue: #logo slot.

density.description: default shows title/subtitle; compact is mark-only. Collapsed Navigation also hides text via CSS.

homeHref.description: Home URL. When set, root is an anchor. Click priority: onBrandClick first; link navigates unless preventDefault.

onBrandClick.description: Brand activation (SPA home / tab reset). Vue: brand-click. Runs before homeHref navigation.

brandInteractive.description: When false, static chrome (no link / keyboard activation).

homeLabel.description: Accessible name override; defaults to title.

states.name: default
states.description: Expanded brand row with title and optional subtitle.

states.name: compact
states.description: Mark-only density (prop or collapsed Navigation rail).

antiPatterns: Do not mount TitleBar on the compact TabBar or duplicate logo+title+subtitle beside Navigation items — Navigation hides header below 48rem by design.
Do not put TitleBar in AppShell header; that slot is NavigationTitle (stack chrome).
Do not hand-roll user-select / contextmenu overrides for brand chrome — use the defaults or opt-out props.
Do not invent a consumer cu- TitleBar pretending to be a library export.

keyboard: Enter/Space activate when interactive without homeHref
Tab focuses the interactive brand control
a11y.focus: Interactive brand is one tab stop; static mode is not focusable.
a11y.labeling: Accessible name is homeLabel or title; compact mode keeps title via aria-label / title tooltip.

responsive.strategy: TitleBar itself is not breakpoint-aware. Visibility is owned by Navigation: sidebar/rail shows __header; compact TabBar hides it (formal DoD).

breakpoints.compact: Must not present TitleBar — Navigation __header is display:none.
breakpoints.medium: Visible in Navigation header; collapsed rail hides text via CSS.
breakpoints.large: Visible in Navigation header with full title/subtitle.

rtl.strategy: Logical flex row; text ellipsis follows document direction.

mechanics: Export TitleBar and place it in Navigation header / #header — not AppShell header (that is NavigationTitle). Defaults: brandInteractive true, preventContextMenu true, userSelectNone true, density default. Click priority: onBrandClick (Vue brand-click) then homeHref unless preventDefault. Host chrome row (Navigation __header) uses min-block-size calc(var(--cu-control-size-active) + 2 * var(--cu-space-1)) to align with NavigationTitle. Compact TabBar must not show this — Navigation hides __header below 48rem.
usage: Import TitleBar from @chameleon-ui/components-react or the React/Vue umbrella.
Pass as Navigation header (React) or #header slot (Vue) — never AppShell header.
Bind onBrandClick / brand-click to reset the home tab, and/or set homeHref.
Optional logo slot/node for SVG; otherwise logoSrc (BrandMark) or letter fallback.

exports.name: TitleBar
exports.description: Sidebar brand header for Navigation header / #header.

exports.name: TitleBarProps
exports.description: Public props including density, homeHref, and brand chrome defaults.
